questions.question: Which of the following is the national sport of Sri Lanka?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** Volley Ball.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Cricket, rugby union, football, volleyball, athletics, and tennis **are among the most popular sports in Sri Lanka.
 
• Volleyball
 
 
• **Volleyball** is the** national sport **of Sri Lanka.
 
• The major volleyball regulatory body in Sri Lanka is called the **Sri Lanka Volleyball Federation (SLVF).**
 
• **R. W. Camack,** then the **Colombo Y.M.C.A.'s Director of Physical Education, **brought volleyball to Sri Lanka in **1916.**
 
• The Federation is composed of** 99 **associated organisations and is run by a **25-person honorary council.**
 
• The current president of SLVF is **Kanchana Jayarathna**, the chairman of Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council and the current secretary general is **A. S. Nalaka**.
 
• It is affiliated with the **Asian Volleyball Confederation** and the** Federation Internationale de Volleyball internationally.**
 
• It has the approval of the **National Olympic Committee (NOC) of Sri Lanka. ​**

questions.question: Viswanathan Anand was the first recipient of the ______ in 1991-92.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Viswanathan Anand is an **Indian chess player**.
 
• He was born on **11 December 1969 in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India**.
 
• He won the** FIDE World Rapid Chess Championship in 2003 and 2017, and the World Blitz Cup in 2000**.
 
• He was the first Indian to be conferred with the **Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award in the year 1991-1992**.
 
• He was honoured with **Padma Vibhushan in the year 2007**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** __Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award __(Now called **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award)**

__
 
• It was instituted in **1991**.
 
• This is the highest sporting award given by the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports**.
 
• It is given for the spectacular and most **outstanding performance in the field of sports by a sportsperson** over a period of four years.
 
• The winner of the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award gets a reward of 7.5 lac rupees previously now increased to **25 lakhs**(As of 2022).​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__** __**Arjuna Award**__

__
 
• Arjuna Award is the** second-highest sporting honour in India**, the **highest being the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award**.
 
• It is given by the **President of India**.
 
• The selection of candidates is done by the** Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports**.

 **Dronacharya Award**__

 
• Dronacharya Award is given to those **coaches who have successfully trained sportspersons or teams** and enabled them to achieve outstanding results in international competitions.
 
• This eminent award was started in the year **1985**.
 
• This award is named after the** legendary guru or teacher Dronacharya**.

questions.question: In which year will India host the Women's Asian Cup in football?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**2022.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India** is all set to host AFC Women's football **Asian Cup India 2022 from 20th January 2022 in Mumbai, Navi Mumbai, and Pune.**
 
• The tournament will witness **12 teams competing for the trophy.**
 
• AFC Women's Asian Cup India will also be the final stage of** Asian qualification for the 2023 FIFA Women's World Cup in Australia and New Zealand.**
 
• Five teams will qualify for the main event directly while two of them will progress to the inter-confederation play-offs.
 
• **Japan is the defending champions of the Women's Asian Cup, having won it in 2018.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Football Women Asian Cup:**

 
 
• It is a quadrennial competition in women's football for national teams which belongs to the Asian football conderation.
 
• It is the oldest women's international football competition and the premier women's football competition in the AFC region for national teams.
 
• It was founded in 1975.

questions.question: The video assistant referee (VAR) system is used in the game of _______.
questions.solution:

• VAR is a match official in association football who reviews decisions made by the referee.
 
• It was first written into the Laws of the Game by the International Football Association Board (IFAB) in 2021.
 
• Operating under the philosophy of "minimal interference, maximum benefit. 
 
• This system seeks to provide a way for "clear and obvious errors" and "serious missed incidents" to be corrected.
